title: Construction Partners, Inc. Announces Preliminary Fiscal 2026 Financial Results and Introduces Fiscal 2027 Outlook

DOTHAN, Ala.


, Nov. 5, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Construction Partners, Inc. (NASDAQ: ROAD) ("CPI" or the "Company"), a vertically integrated civil infrastructure company specializing in the construction and maintenance of roadways in local markets throughout the Sunbelt, today announced preliminary financial results for fiscal year 2026 and introduced fiscal year 2027 outlook ranges.


Fred J. (Jule) Smith, III, the Company's President and Chief Executive Officer, said, "Today, we are announcing our preliminary fiscal 2026 financial results and introducing our fiscal 2027 outlook, reflecting our expectations for continued growth at CPI. Fiscal 2026 was a successful year for CPI, highlighted by record financial performance and significant year-over-year growth, with revenue increasing approximately 30%, net income rising approximately 40%, and Adjusted EBITDA growing approximately 23%. These results reflect the effective execution of our organic and acquisition growth strategies. During the year, we completed seven acquisitions across four of our high-growth Sunbelt states, established four new greenfield locations, and generated organic revenue growth of 7%. These accomplishments strengthened our local market positions, expanded our operating platform, and further positioned CPI for long-term growth."


Smith continued, "I was particularly proud of our team's productivity and disciplined execution despite two primary external headwinds during the fourth quarter. Unusually wet weather in July across several of our largest markets, together with the unprecedented rapid pace and magnitude of increases in diesel fuel costs, affected profitability as we exited the fiscal year. Despite these near-term challenges, our growth strategy remains firmly intact, and we are pleased to introduce our fiscal 2027 outlook, which anticipates approximately 15% growth in both revenue and Adjusted EBITDA at the midpoint of our guidance ranges."


**Preliminary Fiscal 2026 Financial Results**


Revenue in fiscal 2026 is expected to be in the range of $3.660 billion to $3.680 billion, an increase of approximately 30% compared to $2.812 billion in fiscal 2025.


Net income in fiscal 2026 is expected to be in the range of $141.5 million to $142.5 million, an increase of approximately 40% compared to $101.8 million in fiscal 2025.


Adjusted net income(1) in fiscal 2026 is expected to be in the range of $153.3 million to $154.9 million, an increase of approximately 26% compared to $122.0 million in fiscal 2025.


Adjusted EBITDA(1) in fiscal 2026 is expected to be in the range of $520.0 million to $524.0 million, an increase of approximately 23% compared to $423.7 million in fiscal 2025.


Adjusted EBITDA margin(1) in fiscal 2026 is expected to be in the range of 14.21% to 14.24%, compared to 15.1% in fiscal 2025.


The Company's independent registered public accounting firm has not audited, reviewed, compiled or performed any procedures with respect to the above preliminary financial information or completed its audit of the Company's financial statements for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2026. The Company's actual results may differ from these estimates as a result of the Company's year-end closing procedures, review adjustments and other developments that may arise between now and the time the Company's financial results for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2026 are finalized.


**Introducing Fiscal Year 2027 Outlook**


The Company's outlook for fiscal year 2027 with regard to revenue, net income, Adjusted net income, Adjusted EBITDA and Adjusted EBITDA margin is as follows:


- Revenue in the range of $4.175 billion to $4.275 billion
- Net income in the range of $170.9 million to $180.8 million
- Adjusted net income(1) in the range of $174.6 million to $185.4 million
- Adjusted EBITDA(1) in the range of $585.0 million to $620.0 million
- Adjusted EBITDA margin(1) in the range of 14.0% to 14.5%


Smith commented, "Our fiscal 2027 outlook anticipates substantial growth in both revenue and Adjusted EBITDA, including approximately 6% to 8% organic revenue growth, as we continue to expand our operating platform and execute our long-term growth strategy. Looking beyond the first half of fiscal 2027, we see two primary catalysts for meaningful margin improvement: the continued integration of our fiscal 2026 acquisitions and the diminishing impact of elevated diesel fuel costs. As we move through the second half of fiscal 2027, we expect to benefit from completing lower-margin projects in our acquired backlog and replacing them with higher-margin work, while progressively incorporating increased diesel fuel costs into project pricing through our cost pass-through operating model. Additionally, greater economic certainty and improving conditions in residential and commercial construction markets could provide further opportunities for margin expansion.


"Importantly, our three strategic margin improvement levers – building better markets, enhancing vertical integration, and increasing operational scale – remain fundamental to our long-term profitability objectives. Supported by our expanding Sunbelt footprint, differentiated operating model, and disciplined approach to capital allocation, we continue to build momentum. Just one month into fiscal 2027, we have already completed three strategic acquisitions, further strengthening our operating platform and growth opportunities. We remain confident in our ability to deliver sustained growth, margin expansion, and long-term shareholder value creation."


**Conference Call**


The Company will conduct a conference call on Thursday, November 19, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time (9:00 a.m. Central Time) to discuss financial and operating results for the fiscal quarter and year ended September 30, 2026. To access the call live by phone, dial (412) 902-0003 and ask for the Construction Partners call at least 10 minutes prior to the start time. A webcast of the call will also be available live and for later replay on the Company's Investor Relations website at[www.constructionpartners.net](http://www.constructionpartners.net/) .


**About Construction Partners, Inc.**


Construction Partners, Inc. is a vertically integrated civil infrastructure company operating in local markets throughout the Sunbelt in Alabama, Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, Oklahoma, South Carolina, Tennessee and Texas. Supported by its hot-mix asphalt plants, aggregate facilities and liquid asphalt terminals, the Company focuses on the construction, repair and maintenance of surface infrastructure. Publicly funded projects make up the majority of its business and include local and state roadways, interstate highways, airport runways and bridges. The company also performs private sector projects that include paving and sitework for office and industrial parks, shopping centers, local businesses and residential developments. To learn more, visit[www.constructionpartners.net](http://www.constructionpartners.net/) .

**Reconciliation of Non-GAAP Financial Measures**


Adjusted EBITDA represents net income before, as applicable from time to time, (i) interest expense, net, (ii) provision (benefit) for income taxes, (iii) depreciation, depletion, accretion and amortization, (iv) share-based compensation expense, (v) loss on the extinguishment of debt, and (vi) nonrecurring expenses related to transformative acquisitions, which management considers to include transactions of a size that would require clearance under federal antitrust laws. Adjusted EBITDA margin represents Adjusted EBITDA as a percentage of revenues for each period. Adjusted net income represents net income before (i) nonrecurring expenses related to transformative acquisitions, which management considers to include transactions of a size that would require clearance under federal antitrust laws, and (ii) nonrecurring fees associated with financing arrangements incurred in connection with transformative acquisitions. These metrics are supplemental measures of our operating performance that are neither required by, nor presented in accordance with, GAAP. These measures have limitations as analytical tools and should not be considered in isolation or as an alternative to net income or any other performance measure derived in accordance with GAAP as an indicator of our operating performance. We present Adjusted EBITDA, Adjusted EBITDA margin and Adjusted net income because management uses these measures as key performance indicators, and we believe that securities analysts, investors and others use these measures to evaluate companies in our industry. Our calculation of Adjusted EBITDA, Adjusted EBITDA margin and Adjusted net income may not be comparable to similarly named measures reported by other companies. Potential differences may include differences in capital structures, tax positions and the age and book depreciation of intangible and tangible assets.
